formal: My brother requires a guarantor for a £25,000 loan to purchase a van for his work. My parents have asked me to act as the guarantor. The plan is for me to sign the guarantor form this weekend. I customarily submit financial decisions of this kind to you for review; you are the one I have consulted for years. I have no basis of my own on which to judge a van loan, and I will sign without having decided. What is your view?
